home.work.note: We choose focused products we can finish, then announce them when they are ready.
home.work.noctis_lead: Route browser traffic through your proxies while banking and video calls keep their current connection.
home.work.noctis_f1: Add a share link or subscription URL, then route each site with rules
home.work.noctis_f2: Latency checks switch your browser away from a failing server
home.work.noctis_f3: Install and remove it without administrator access
home.work.aria2t_lead: Aria2t puts a real interface on the aria2 download engine, in the terminal and in the browser, and the queue keeps running after you close either one.
home.work.aria2t_f1: Inspect piece maps, peers and per-file progress when a download stalls
home.work.aria2t_f2: Schedule speed limits and reserve the night for large files
home.work.aria2t_f3: Check finished files with SHA-256 and fetch mismatched data again

home.how.intro: Each product begins with a tool one of us needs. We keep using it after release, on our own machines.
home.how.p1_t: We start with a tool we need
home.how.p1_b: Noctis and Aria2t began with a task one of us could not complete with the tools at hand. We kept each product focused enough to finish.
home.how.p2_t: We use our products each day
home.how.p2_b: We run each product on our own machines. That daily use exposes rough edges before many users need to report them.
home.how.p3_b: Other developers solved the underlying technical problems. We build the interface and workflow that put their work in your hands.
home.how.p4_t: We keep things close to home
home.how.p4_b: Your machine is our default. We add a remote service only when the product needs one, and we state what that service stores.
home.how.p5_t: We test against the real thing
home.how.p5_b: Our tests run the product under the same conditions you use it in. They cover real workflows and catch failures that isolated checks miss.
home.floor.intro: You can hold us to these four promises across every product we release.
home.floor.f1_t: It's yours, and it stays yours
home.floor.f1_b: You can export what you put in as readable data. We do not use it to build a profile of you.
home.floor.f2_b: We put no advertising in our products and take no payment to favor someone else's interests.
home.floor.f3_t: You can read what it does before you trust it
home.floor.f3_b: We document each behavior that can affect your trust, next to the product that performs it.
home.floor.f4_t: It keeps working if we stop
home.floor.f4_b: If we retire a product, installed copies keep working on their current machines. We will announce the decision before support ends.
